payload.name: ExtractAllExplicitInspirationSources
payload.description: During extraction, when a user explicitly names a source of inspiration or motivation, preserve every named source as its own memory item.
content: When a user message explicitly states that something or someone inspired or motivated them (e.g., 'X really inspired me', 'Y motivated me'), extract a memory for each distinct named source, including specific people, even if the same message also describes an activity, scene, or broader reflection.

Do not summarise the message into only the most salient event and drop the named person; if the source is a person, record the fact that this person inspires the user (as a profile/preference/event as appropriate) with the message timestamp as evidence.
Stop once every explicit inspiration source in the message has been captured; do not add speculative sources beyond what the user states.

solves: Extraction drops explicit inspiration sources when the same message also describes a vivid activity, so later questions about what inspires the user miss named people. Applies when a user explicitly says someone or something inspired them while adding context; ensure each named source is preserved. Does not apply to routine event summaries without an explicit inspiration claim or to inferring inspiration from behavior.
